sentences.en: The rain was dripping through a leak in the roof.
sentences.zh: 屋顶有个漏洞，雨水正滴下来。

sentences.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
sentences.zh: 爆炸可能是由于天然气泄漏引起的。

sentences.en: He made sure the story was leaked to the media.
sentences.zh: 他确保把这个故事泄露给了媒体。

senses.zh: 使渗漏，泄露；漏，渗；泄漏出去；透露
泄漏；漏洞，裂缝；泄漏出的液体（或气体）；（秘密信息的）透露；撒尿；漏电
